note: Season 0 rounds. Lock is always release minus 48 hours, except behavioral series (wikipedia, google_trends), which lock before the measured week begins because their outcome data publishes daily. Times are UTC. release_estimated=true means the pollster does not preannounce an exact time; if a wave slips, the round resolves on the next published wave. Nothing here is written automatically: tools/generate_rounds.py drafts candidates into questions/candidates/ and never touches this file, and every round below is frozen by the commit that added it. The weekly families (wiki_top10, the Trends brand basket) are rolled forward from a reviewed round rather than rewritten each week -- the generator refuses to emit one whose wording it cannot rebuild from the reviewed original, so a rolled-forward week asks the question a human approved and not a paraphrase of it.
